periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, approximately 65 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, angled toward the snout.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval, with vertical elongation where height is approximately 1.5 times the width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Moderate downward tapering observed at the lower medial margins.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Smooth, shallow U-shaped profile across the posterior edge.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Consistent thick band, covering roughly 25% of the visible dorsal length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation, positioned at the lateral-superior boundaries of the cranium.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Convex and highly uniform rounded curvature.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible contrast gradient in pelage luminance, with bright white on the neck/cranial region transitioning to a cream/yellowish hue on the posterior dorsal area.
